'''Squad Three-Zero-One''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter|TwinTail]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit composed of the Jedi [[Te Corso]], [[Asaak Dan]], [[Drok]], and [[Sayar Dun'La]], who met up with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] to discuss the possibility of the [[New Jedi Order]] aiding the joined Anti-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] treaty of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and [[Empire-in-exile]] in [[137 ABY]].
